pr_title: Feature: Added hashes tab to properties window
pr_body:
### Description

I'm adding hash page to storage object's properties window.

### Motivation and Context

- Closes #3722
- [x] Add hashes page
  - [x] Calculate hashes and display
  - [x] Add copy button
  - [x] Display ProgressRing when loading
  - [x] Display TextBlock that show 'task was failed'
- [x] Fix NavigationViewStoreStyle

- [x] Tested the changes for accessibility

issue_context.title: Feature: Add hashes tab to the properties window
issue_context.body:
### Describe the solution
[HashTab](http://implbits.com/products/hashtab/) is a plugin of Windows Explorer.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/11289158/109131328-a78c0e80-778d-11eb-9186-78b11bcd1ff6.png)

I want the same feature that build in Files.

### Requirements
- Add hashes tab to the properties windows
- Display hashes (starting with CRC32, MD5 and SHA-1) in the list (should follow the design pattern in the details tab)

### Files version

2.3.12.0

### Windows version

10.0.19043.2006
comments: @yaichenbaum Please let me know if you'd like to implement it or welcome the PR.
@PMExtra A PR would be great, would you like to work on this?

Thought to add since 7zip is now integrated the hash features might be in it too. The 7zip program support these. A custom string check could be done too with little performance issues since there's only 5 to check for
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/26977075/185786177-583f1097-5a9b-4a6a-bdd8-9aecccbd2108.png)
What kinds of settings are available in HashTab?

> What kinds of settings are available in HashTab?

I just installed HashTab on a VM.

It has the following features :
- A link to license the software, that seems like it doesn't work anymore
- A settings link, which opens the following window : https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/109022579/195403031-21ea85ba-4dba-4685-aee0-5b45d8b4de4c.png
- A "Hash Comparison" text box, and a "Compare a file..." button
- The "main" thing that shows the hash values.


That is a screenshot of the full window : 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/109022579/195403307-10ea5b02-e907-4a30-9c90-d178ed324c13.png)



PS : You might have meant a completely different think by saying "What kind of settings are available in HashTab?", but, that is what I understood... I don't have any idea how to code so I cannot get involved anymore in this thread.
